### Why P vs NP is genuinely hard

There are **proven barriers** to existing proof techniques:

| Barrier | What it blocks |
|---|---|
| Relativization (1975) | Most diagonalization approaches |
| Natural Proofs (1994) | Large classes of combinatorial arguments |
| Algebrization (2009) | Most algebraic extensions of diagonalization |

These aren't just philosophical - they're theorems proving that entire *families* of approaches **cannot work**.

- Survey current research directions honestly
- Help you work through specific sub-problems
- Point out where informal arguments break down
